finding.summary: Synchronous response reads block on an asynchronous pipe read.
finding.explanation: Every synchronous Stream.Read call invokes the asynchronous PipeReader-backed ReadAsync operation and blocks with GetAwaiter().GetResult(). When response bytes are not already available, the calling thread remains occupied until pipe I/O completes.
